siteIssues.title: No valid sitemap URLs discovered
evidence: Sitemap fetch failed https://firecraw.com/sitemap.xml: fetch failed
siteIssues.recommendation: Publish a valid XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.
siteIssues.acceptanceCriteria: The sitemap returns HTTP 200 and lists canonical, indexable URLs only.
siteIssues.currentBehavior: sitemap status: 0 Sitemap fetch failed https://firecraw.com/sitemap.xml: fetch failed
siteIssues.impact: Can materially affect important rankings, templates, user journeys, or content decisions.
prerequisites: Preserve the current implementation and baseline before making changes.
verificationSteps: The sitemap returns HTTP 200 and lists canonical, indexable URLs only.
siteIssues.rollbackPlan: Restore the previous URL/indexation/configuration state from version control and re-run the crawl before proceeding.

siteIssues.title: HTTP 500 response
siteIssues.recommendation: Restore the page or update all internal links and sitemap entries to the intended destination.

evidenceSource: Audited HTTP response and HTML: http://localhost:3001/
siteIssues.impact: May block access, indexation, data integrity, or release readiness.
prerequisites: Preserve the current implementation and baseline before making changes.
verificationSteps: The intended URL returns HTTP 200 and obsolete URLs are no longer linked or submitted.
siteIssues.rollbackPlan: Restore the previous URL/indexation/configuration state from version control and re-run the crawl before proceeding.
